name: Ozon Simulator 📦
desc:
🚛 We present to your attention a new game Ozon order pickup point, in which you can place/send orders, as in real life.

Process the most orders and get to the top 🏆
To open the phone, press the letter (Z) 📞
To bend down, press the letter (C) 👆
Run - key (Shift) 💪

Add the game to your favorites to save it and like it! 👍
